name: Samantha Lee
comment: Absolutely amazing! Jonas is a fantastic instructor. He explains everything so clearly, and the projects really helped me understand how to build real-world apps. Highly recommended!

name: Carlos Méndez
comment: Very complete course with up-to-date content. It took me from basic concepts to advanced patterns. Some sections felt a bit fast, but overall it was a great learning experience.

name: Lina Gómez
comment: I loved this course! It helped me land my first frontend job. The explanations about hooks and state management were super clear and easy to apply in real projects.

name: David Zhang
comment: Great structure, great teaching, and lots of value. I've taken several React courses, and this one is by far the most complete. Totally worth the time investment.
